review_type: independent read-only predeployment review; proof saved after root confirmed start
scope: Same canonical minibatches, padding, dtypes, order, metric reduction and fresh forward/KL after every proposal.
Once-only deterministic prefix device admission, 8 GiB logical payload bound, CPU count metadata, explicit worker/tensor placement.
Default disabled; original shuffled optimizer path and CPU-cache fallback retained.
All reader/critic work joined before cache references are released; genuine OOM remains visible without replay.

Preflight checks every canonical input across 85199 samples, six shuffled batches, three joint forward/backward cases, immutable checkpoint/optimizers/RNG/source and whole-game exclusion before finite ABBA replays.
Same immutable consolidated baseline ML runtime; candidate changes limited to packed_rollouts and streaming_ppo, common timed driver, both Adam states and PCG restored.
All four timings preserved; unequal retry work separated, exact guard decisions required for adoption.
Shared lock, prior process termination, runtime hashes and native awake proof gated before start.
Native temporary awake guard independently reviewed: fixed UTC expiry and monotonic maximum, no persistent power/services/WSL/compute changes.
resolved_prelaunch_findings: Aligned coordinator and timed-driver cache-budget argument.
Host runtime telemetry predates device cache fields; host-only assertions permit absent device counters as zero while GPU fields remain mandatory.
Aligned native manifest and state filenames with actual day-awake guard.
limitations: This review is static and verifies the existing local CPU test log; it does not claim GPU numerical or performance success before evidence arrives.
8 GiB bounds logical input payload only; TensorFlow allocator overhead and active model/optimizer/activation memory require additional VRAM.
OOM and placement failures abort visibly; no automatic optimizer or RPC replay is introduced.
Cached tensors are immutable; their containing input dictionaries are documented caller-read-only.
Only one saved update is benchmarked; production resident game-worker memory pressure is not covered.
GPU A/A numerical and retry variability must remain visible in final comparisons.
